## Activity

During June 2022, River Outreach recorded 61 captures. This activity provides the basis for the review of image quality and grading outcomes for the month. The capture total is reported as provided and is used consistently across the operational summary.

The activity result indicates that image capture was completed at the site during the reporting period. No additional activity measures are included in this report.

## Image quality

Of the 61 captures, 9 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 14.8. This result identifies the proportion of captures that could not proceed through grading and is presented alongside the total capture activity for June 2022.

## Grading

Grading identified 4 referable results. The median lag was 0, indicating that the midpoint of the recorded interval from capture to grading was 0. The grading outcome is reported separately from image quality so that referable results and ungradable captures remain distinct measures. Together, these figures summarise the River Outreach activity, image quality, and grading position for June 2022.
